import urllib.request

url = "https://rest.genenames.org/fetch/symbol/WBP4"
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'Accept': 'application/json', 'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
try:

        res = json.loads(resp.read().decode())

import urllib.request
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

url = "https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/efetch.fcgi?db=pubmed&id=19592703&retmode=xml"
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
    xml_data = resp.read()
    root = ET.fromstring(xml_data)
    title = root.find(".//ArticleTitle").text
    abstract = "".join(root.find(".//Abstract").itertext()) if root.find(".//Abstract") is not None else ""
    print("Title:", title)
    print("Abstract:", abstract[:500])
